retire_scope: only a fresh154 local disabled metadata wait controller that was never registered as a runtime attempt
retire_only_if: its request remains disabled and execution_allowed is false
a read-only ledger snapshot contains no reservations[].id equal to its attempt_id
a read-only ledger snapshot contains no attempts row for its attempt_id with status reserved or running
no live child PID or controller receipt reports running/reserved
no completed receipt or downstream binding refers to it
do_not_retire: any registered, reserved, running, failed, or completed Root142 attempt
any existing request, receipt, typed H5, conversion report, XMF, bed report, or render output
any shared ledger row, shared lock, controller, or old storage reservation
successor_rule: If retirement criteria pass, Root may create one new attempt id and one new reservation; downstream bindings must use the new id and actual producer receipts. No completed conversion is repeated.
